name: Jointcowl
description: Hold the grip at the hip and let the segments hang slack so the loose iron screens the legs.

name: Flat Rivet
description: A flick of the wrist drops the tip of the chain onto the foe's shin in a short stinging rap.

name: Towing Slither
description: Turning the handle a quarter flips the loose segments up into the foe's forearm and spoils the guard.

name: Shifting Hingebar
description: Skip one short step off the line while the chain trails behind and stays clear of both feet.

name: Stout Writhe
description: With the elbow pinned to the ribs only the forearm snaps and the tip bites with little warning.

name: Angled Linkpin
description: Drawing the chain back in a tight loop after each throw knocks aside any thrust that meets it.

name: Rivetlid
description: Swing the chain in a slow figure eight beside the body so that moving iron covers the flank.

name: Leaden Segment
description: Bring the whole chain over the shoulder in one arc and land the tip on the foe's collar line.

name: Quick Spineplate
description: The chain sweeps flat at ankle height and the segments rake the shins of a closing foe.

name: Writhelid
description: Let the chain curl once about the foe's wrist and tug to hold the hand away from the body.

name: Skipping Jangle
description: Rolling back off the heel lets the chain swing out in front and cover the retreat.

name: Eyelethusk
description: Twirl the chain from the raised hand so its tail turns aside low cuts before they reach the legs.

name: Downward Tailblade
description: Snap the chain out level at the waist and pull the tip home before the foe can seize it.

name: Sharp Coilend
description: A flick from below sends the tip up under the chin and rattles the head of an unwary foe.

name: Catching Chainhead
description: Throw one loop over the foe's raised weapon and pull down so the point sinks toward the ground.

name: Shifting Whiplink
description: Step back on the first count and let the chain fall slack on the second so the foe overreaches.

name: Writhepause
description: Let the tip fall and drag it hard across the foe's lead foot to ruin the planted stance.

name: Hooding Eyelet
description: Pass the chain behind the back from hand to hand so a thrust meets only swinging iron.

name: Planted Linkpin
description: Stand with tendons loose and knees soft so that the body rides each swing of the chain.

name: Sharp Rivet
description: Draw the throwing arm back along the ribs and release forward so the tip lands with the whole arm's pull.

name: Rivetblow
description: The tip is cast sideways at the ribs and hauled back before any hand can close on it.

name: Jointbump
description: Flick the last ring of the chain in quick repeated taps at the foe's face to keep the head back.

name: Catching Whiplink
description: Cast the chain low so it winds around a knee and holds the leg while the wielder moves around it.

name: Rattlehit
description: Drive the hip around first and let the chain follow so the crack lands with the body behind it.

name: Skipping Hingebar
description: Slip sideways out of a rush while the chain is reeled in beside the body and stays out of reach.

name: Rivetreview
description: Feel the pull of a foe's grip through the chain and judge the foe's strength from the weight of it.

name: Jointstay
description: Set the bones square over the feet so the swing of the chain cannot drag the wielder off balance.

name: Low Rasp
description: Lift the tip high and let it fall in a steep arc onto the foe's head and shoulder.

name: Hooding Segment
description: Bend the elbow and swing the chain across the front so the iron turns a cut aside.

name: Open Rattle
description: The last heavy segment is thrown straight at the foe's belly and drives in point first.

name: Catching Jangle
description: Hook the chain around the rear ankle and heave so the foe's footing fails mid stride.

name: Swaying Tailblade
description: Close in with a quick step while the foe's chain arm is still wide and smother the next throw.

name: Joint Wedge
description: Hold a breath of qi in the grip hand and let the ringed chain hang ready to screen the body.

name: Rasphit
description: Send a breath of qi along the chain on the snap so the tip lands harder than the arm alone.

name: Jointpause
description: Spin the chain overhead with a trickle of qi so the whirling rings turn aside cuts and arrows.

name: Rattlewedge
description: The tip hooks behind the foe's weapon hand and tugs so the blade dips off its line.

name: Nabbing Coilend
description: Pour a little qi into the segments as they wrap the arm so the wrap holds tight and heavy.

name: Writhepace
description: Run lightly forward while the chain trails behind and qi lifts each stride from the ground.

name: Eyeletgauge
description: Listen to the faint ring of the segments through the grip and read where the foe stands.

name: Rivetpause
description: Carry the coiled chain over one forearm and move so the loops can be loosed in a single motion.

name: Straight Chainhead
description: The chain slips free of the forearm in one long cast that reaches the foe's guarding arm.

name: Pulling Eyelet
description: Draw the tip back through the foe's open guard with a sharp pull that spoils the foe's rhythm.

name: Fixing Joint
description: Throw the tip over the foe's shoulder and pull the head down and forward off balance.

name: Easing Slither
description: Move in even steps with the chain coiled and silent so the foe hears no warning.

name: Resting Hingebar
description: Stand with the segments rattling lightly in hand so the foe watches the iron and not the feet.

name: Stopping Rasp
description: Shake the chain loudly on one side and cast on the other so the foe guards the wrong place.

name: Quick Rivet
description: Spin the handle between the fingers to flick the tip in a quick stream of taps that pins the foe's guard.

name: Rivetdash
description: Slam the weighted tail down on the foe's thigh with a quick stepping lunge.

name: Single Writhe
description: A low sidearm throw rakes the segments across the foe's shins before they are pulled clear.

name: Planted Joint
description: Let the chain rebound off a blocked cut and swing back so that the guard runs straight into a strike.

name: Rivetamble
description: Retreat while the chain drags along the ground between wielder and foe to snag any pursuit.

name: Eyeletcount
description: Pulse a little qi down the chain so the segments ring together and the swing carries more force.

name: Rivethusk
description: Hold the handle with the thumb along its spine so a hooked barb cannot twist the wrist.

name: Low Segment
description: A stiff arm throw jabs the barbed point straight forward into a gap in the foe's guard.

name: Fouling Rattle
description: Hook the barb into the foe's sleeve or strap and pull so the foe leans toward the wielder.

name: Descending Spineplate
description: Flick the barb at the height of the foe's eyes so the foe blinks and falls back.

name: Locking Slither
description: Catch the barb in the foe's cloak and wind the chain once to tie the arm to the body.

name: Eyelet Trot
description: Drift a quarter circle around the foe while the chain keeps the barb pointed at the foe's front.

name: Ready Linkpin
description: Gather slack into the free hand in small loops while moving so the chain is neither loose nor tight.

name: Descending Tailblade
description: Pull the chain taut for a heartbeat and then release it forward so the snap lands sharply.

name: Fixing Writhe
description: A throw made with the chain slack arrives late and from an angle the foe has not guarded.

name: Solid Chainhead
description: Hold the chain taut across the body at a slant so that a descending cut slides off the iron.

name: Light Jangle
description: Step in as the chain is drawn and step out as it is released so the feet keep time with the snap.

name: Hitching Whiplink
description: Pull against the foe's hold until the foe leans and then loosen all at once so the foe stumbles forward.

name: Watching Tailblade
description: Sense through the slack of the chain whether the foe grips hard or is about to let go.
